verdict.rationale: Kick's MCP/CLI lets an AI agent query transactions, generate reports, and 'execute bookkeeping changes... all with your approval' (kick-docs-16, kick-docs-24, kick-docs-26), and journal entries are a real double-entry construct in Kick's ledger (kick-supp-journal-entries). However, there is no documented workflow for an agent to draft a standalone journal entry via API and place it in a distinct accountant review queue — the closest analogues are AI categorization deferring low-confidence transactions for manual review (kick-supp-categorization) and generic 'approval' gating, not a journal-entry-specific queue. Missing for 10: explicit API/MCP endpoint for creating a journal entry, a named review-queue object/state for pending entries, and confirmation that accountants specifically approve/reject agent-drafted entries.
